description: This file defines a mock weather service providing simulated current weather and forecast data, without external dependencies, for testing or demonstration purposes.

classes.name: MockWeather
classes.description: Immutable dataclass representing current weather data for a city.

classes.name: MockForecastDay
classes.description: Immutable dataclass representing a single day's weather forecast.

methods.name: int|float _compute_mock_temperature(city: str, units: Units)
methods.description: Calculates a deterministic-ish mock temperature based on the city name and units.

methods.name: str _compute_mock_description(seed: str)
methods.description: Returns a simple mock weather description based on a seed string.

methods.name: dict get_mock_weather(*, city: str, units: Units)
methods.description: Generates a mock current weather payload for a specified city.

methods.name: dict get_mock_forecast(*, city: str, days: int)
methods.description: Generates a mock forecast payload for a specified city over a number of days.

ctags.name: get_mock_forecast
ctags.pattern: /^def get_mock_forecast(*, city: str, days: int) -> dict:$/

ctags.name: get_mock_weather
ctags.pattern: /^def get_mock_weather(*, city: str, units: Units) -> dict:$/
